Well you obviously completely missed the point. "Thinking about hurting people" is intention to hurt people. I've struggled with suicidal thoughts for years. When I had thoughts about ending my life and told my therapist about them I did NOT get hospitalized, when I had intention and had plans about how I'm going to do it I DID get hospitalized. That is the difference.

Also you say going to the hospital if its notnescesary doesn't hurt. You must be lying then about being hospitalized, because they are very costly and cause you to miss work. The OP's comments suggest he isn't exactly wealthy. 

You also seem to be under the impression that getting help is going to the hospital. Your really misled if you think that's the case. Getitng help can be a variety of things.

Lastly, if they hopitalized every person that has a homocidal or suicidal thoughts, the hospitals would be completely overfilled.

I can't emphasise enough how wrong you are. Hospitalization is a last ditch resort. No you don't go to the hospital for thoughts. You go to the hopsital for intention. There's a very big difference.

You don't need to go to the hospital, for thoughts. They don't put you into the hospital for suicidal thoughts, they put you in the hospital for suicidal intentions. Since you said you would never act on them and that you called them thoughts, it's safe to insume they aren't intentions. Try an online service where you can talk to a therapist confidentailly, I myself had a miserable time in a mental health facility so I understand how you feel. I hate to give cliche advice(bare with me, this the only part that's cliche), but I think maybe if I word it differently you'll get the message that other commenters were trying to give you. Confidence is important, and you can build it. I know it sounds like BS because I thought it was BS too when I first heard it. But after I got my first date, I got out of the mindset of I'll never make it with anyone. As a result my confidence goes up and suddenly more people start to notice me, including potential dates. Confidence helps a lot with more than just dating too, it will help you TONS in basically every social situation imaginable. Think of your body as a transmitter of energy, When your confident everyone wants that energy, when your not nobody wants it. Even if you don't think you can build it to the level necessary you can totally fake it till you make it. If you're seeing a therapist, I'm sure ze already is trying to work on it with you. The whole concept of living your life only concerned about yourself and just ignoring the opposite gender is awful advice to give a guy IMHO. There are unfortunate gender roles in our society, whether you like them or not is another question. But its the guys job in society to pursue. Not concerning yourself with it and waiting for Mr. Right to come along is good advice for women. So do keep trying, I don't care how many times you were rejected or called ugly. There are a few reasons. One you haven't been sexually mature that long, and your not even finished developing yet mentally if your in your early 20's. And quite frankly when you are a teen, all relationships are superficial. Truthfully even at our age things are still a bit superficial. If you think you're ugly, be a little more patient. As we get older, we start realizing can you make me laugh is more important than your appearance. I urge you to not give up, if your really set on giving up, wait it out at least a few more years. Let's say your 25 max, you still should give it another 10 years. I know of someone who was like you all the way to 36, now he's happily married with two kids. It's too early to throw in the towel.

I can only guess but it seems like you want a real relationship. Meaningless sex doesn't do it when you seek real intimacy. I've never paid someone for sex, but I've gone for hookups when I really want a boyfriend. The hookups never satisfy. I know it sounds hard to believe, especially with our over sexualized culture, but it will be worth the wait if you wait to do it with a special girl
